# description
<!-- @starci/seperator -->
Interview questions on the ideas every backend framework is built on — inversion of control, the request pipeline's fixed layer order, separating config from code, structured logging, and normalizing errors at one point. Grounded in the lesson's own worked examples across languages, not tied to one framework.
